name: Silhouette Movie Poster
description: Using image tracing and a grid system, I made this Dune 2 poster for my favourite character in the movie, the psychotic Feyd-Rautha. I love the minimalist look of the poster, but I feel like much of the original expression has been lost. I tried communicating more form with more lines or gray shapes, but I was unsuccessful. I'm also proud of my use of esoteric fonts - I usually struggle with typefaces.
